builds.desc: With the added self-damage from Fury 3 and Deft Harpoon+, Robin activates Desperation 3 after her first duel, whether or not the enemy damages her.

builds.name: Distance Bait
builds.desc: This build is an anti mage/bow build. With +2 to all stats upon being attacked, plus another +6 to both Resistance and Defence, combined with either Iceberg or Bonfire, means there is a lot of potential for damage on the opponent's turn.
